AirCare is a screening and engagement aid, not a diagnostic device. Values are measured relative to the camera frame, so compare a patient only with their own earlier sessions, with the camera in a similar position. Flags are prompts for a clinician to look, not conclusions. Video never leaves the device; only summary numbers are stored.
